name: Jamul Indian Village
notes: Both photos are clear, well-lit shots of a full printed menu (two pages of a red menu binder). Photo 1 covers appetizers, salt & pepper dishes, noodle soup and noodle dishes; photo 2 covers lumpia, shu mai, teriyaki bowls, beverages, and chicken/pork/vegetarian rice dishes. Non-alcoholic and alcoholic beverage listings (soda, tea, boba, beer, wine) were skipped as drink items, not dishes.
